original.description: German troops at a meal after the fall of Liège, August 1914, as reproduced in "Der Krieg 1914-19 in Wort und Bild".
original.date: August 1914 (subject); the record gives the plate as "by 1919"
original.archive: Wikimedia Commons; the record cites "Der Krieg 1914-19 in Wort und Bild", Deutsches Verlagshaus Bong & Co., Berlin, 1919

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: colorize if the pack wants one warm human image in the Liège sequence — feldgrau and the field kitchen are documented.

caption: German troops at a meal after the fall of Liège, August 1914. Twelve days were spent here that the plan had not allowed for.
credit: Original photograph: Robert Sennecke; published in "Der Krieg 1914-19 in Wort und Bild", Deutsches Verlagshaus Bong & Co., Berlin, 1919; via Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. Named photographer (Robert Sennecke, a Berlin press photographer), which is better provenance than most of the German plates in this batch, though the holding archive of the negative is still unknown.
